description: Defines a health check route for the Flask application using Flask-Smorest. It provides an endpoint at '/' which returns a JSON message indicating the health status of the application.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flask view for the health check endpoint that returns a simple JSON health status.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the health check endpoint and returns a JSON indicating the application is healthy.

ctags.name: blp
ctags.pattern: /^blp = Blueprint("Healt Check", "health check", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route"/

fields.name: blp = Blueprint("Healt Check", "health check", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route"/
